Family notes

What I have written down so far. Some dates are still missing.

## Rowan Vale

This is me. Willowford. I put these notes together.

Born on 4 May 1994.

His father was Martin Vale. His mother was Clara Vale.

## Martin Vale

My dad, Martin. From Willowford, later Harbourfield.

Born on 2 February 1962. Died on 9 June 2019.

His partner was Clara Vale. His father was Jonah Vale.

## Clara Vale

My mum, Clara. She kept the photographs.

Born on 1965.

Her partner was Martin Vale.

## Jonah Vale

Jonah worked at the harbour. He came from Alder Vale as a boy.

Born around 1930. Died around 1998.

His father was Ellis Vale. His mother was Marta Vale.

## Ellis Vale

Ellis came from Alder Vale and was a harness-maker. Both years below are approximate.

Born around 1899. Died around 1971.

His partner was Marta Vale.

## Marta Vale

Marta came from Alder Vale. One note gives 1902 and another gives 1904. This record contains an unresolved discrepancy.

Born around 1902 or around 1904. Died around 1984.

Her partner was Ellis Vale.
